description: Find the ad and analytics pixels a website runs. Checks the homepage and every Google Tag Manager container it loads, nested ones included, for meta, tiktok, openai, google_analytics, google_ads, microsoft_ads, linkedin, pinterest, snapchat, x, reddit, hotjar, microsoft_clarity, callrail. Containers that 50 or more websites load belong to a platform or agency and are left out. Answers from the last check when the website was checked before (checkedAt), otherwise checks it during the call, which can take up to 20 seconds. Charges 0.25 credits when the homepage answered, also when it runs no pixels; a homepage that never answers is free.
name: websites_find_pixels

found.description: true when the homepage answered and was checked

pixelIds.description: vendor:id where the markup shows the id, e.g. "meta:1234567890" or "google_ads:AW-123456789"

pixels.description: Vendors whose pixel or tag runs on the website, e.g. meta, google_ads

title: Find the ad and analytics pixels a website runs
